description: This is a group for LTHS students!
summary: Our app is an audio-visual story telling experience that works to display temperature data over time using the NASA SVC 5207 maps from 1880 to 2023 to showcase the change of temperature throughout the years. We used algorithms to create musical tunes to show the chaos of global warming, which can be heard throughout the story. It describes what happened that year, and slowly builds the narrative of how global warming came into play. It uses various different sound effects, such as birds, to develop an enriching audio experience. However, a narrator is also available for low-vision users who can't read the text, describing what happened every year.
details: Our app is an interactive timeline that uses both Python and Java Script to tell the story of climate change. We use global climate temperature abnormality maps found on the NASA EIC over a span of over 100 years to track and visualize the worsening of global warming. In this simulation, we hoped to convey an urgent message by linking cooler climate trends with natural sounds and warmer climate trends with mechanical and artificial whirring. As the world continues to plummet into a future where all life forms, including humans, would be deprived of livable natural habitats due to climate change, we hope that our project can inform its users of the urgency of global warming.
